title: Dowman before the North London derby v Fàbregas and Henry at the same age
checked: Spurs v Arsenal provisionally Sat 5 Dec 2026 at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium (Hayters + On Tour fixture lists; TV may move it, so the script says 'in December'). Dowman born 31 Dec 2009 = 16y 339d on 5 Dec (arithmetic). Youngest Champions League player 15y 308d at Slavia Prague, 4 Nov 2025 (Wikipedia + Sports Mole). Youngest PL scorer 16y 73d, Arsenal 2-0 Everton, Emirates, 14 Mar 2026, 90+7 on the break into an empty net, beating James Vaughan's 16y 270d (premierleague.com + SI). Youngest PL starter 16y 144d at Crystal Palace, 24 May 2026 (WTOP/AP + Wikipedia). Arsenal 2025-26 champions on 85 points, City 78 (Wikipedia + ground.news); Dowman youngest PL title winner (ESPN + Wikipedia). Spurs 1-4 Arsenal, 22 Feb 2026, and Arsenal 4-1 Spurs, 23 Nov 2025 (thfcdb + Sports Mole + Sky). Fàbregas (born 4 May 1987) at the same age = 7 Apr 2004: debut v Rotherham 28 Oct 2003 at 16y 177d; first goal v Wolves 2 Dec 2003, 5-1, tapping in Wiltord's cross near the end, 16y 212d; no league games in 2003-04 (Arsenal.com + Sports Mole + Wikipedia). Henry (born 17 Aug 1977) at the same age = 22 Jul 1994: no first-team games; Monaco debut 31 Aug 1994 v Nice, aged 17 (Wikipedia + 90min). Henry 228 Arsenal goals, club record; Ian Wright 185 second (Wikipedia + Arsenal.com). Dowman's exact appearance count is one-source, so it is left out. The Everton goal was a long solo run into an empty net, which the game cannot film, so the gameplay recreates Fàbregas's tap-in instead (Wiltord's cross; side of the cross not sourced, so it comes from the seed).

lines.text: Arsenal go to Tottenham in December with a sixteen-year-old who has already broken half the record book.
lines.say: Arsenal go to Tottnum in December, with a sixteen year old who has already broken half the record book.

lines.text: At fifteen, Max Dowman became the youngest player in Champions League history.
lines.say: At fifteen, Max Dowmun became the youngest player in Champions League history.

scene.headline: Dowman, 15, makes Champions League history
scene.standfirst: The Arsenal teenager comes on at Slavia Prague aged 15 years and 308 days, the youngest player the competition has ever seen.

lines.text: Then Everton. Ninety-seventh minute, their keeper up for a corner. Dowman runs half the pitch and rolls it into an empty net.
lines.say: Then Everton. Ninety seventh minute, their keeper up for a corner. Dowmun runs half the pitch, and rolls it into an empty net.

scene.note: Dowman 90+7 · the youngest scorer in Premier League history

lines.text: Sixteen years and seventy-three days. The old record lasted twenty years. He beat it by six months.
lines.say: Sixteen years and seventy three days. The old record lasted twenty years. He beat it by six months.

lines.text: And in May, Arsenal were champions, seven points clear. Dowman, the youngest title winner ever.
lines.say: And in May, Arsenal were champions, seven points clear. Dowmun, the youngest title winner ever.

lines.text: So what had Arsenal's two greatest number tens done at exactly the same age?
lines.say: So what had Arsenal's legends done, at exactly the same age?

lines.text: Cesc Fàbregas, April two thousand and four. Already Arsenal's youngest ever player, at sixteen.
lines.say: Sesk Fabbregass, April, two thousand and four. Already Arsenal's youngest ever player, at sixteen.

lines.text: His first goal: League Cup, Wolves. Wiltord crosses, and the sixteen-year-old taps it in.
lines.say: His first goal. League Cup, Wolves. Weeltor crosses, and the sixteen year old taps it in.

lines.text: But Premier League games by this age? Zero.
Thierry Henry, July nineteen ninety-four. He hadn't played a single game for Monaco. His debut came a month later.
lines.say: Teeairee Onree, July, nineteen ninety four. He hadn't played a single game for Monakoh. His debut came a month later.

lines.text: Line all three up by age, and Dowman is miles ahead of both.
lines.say: Line all three up by age, and Dowmun is miles ahead of both.

lines.text: But a slow start meant nothing. Henry ended up with two hundred and twenty-eight Arsenal goals, still the club record.
lines.say: But a slow start meant nothing. Onree ended up with two hundred and twenty eight Arsenal goals. Still the club record.

lines.text: And Tottenham? Arsenal put four past them twice last season.
lines.say: And Tottnum? Arsenal put four past them, twice, last season.

scene.note: After a 4-1 at the Emirates in November

lines.text: So Dowman is ahead of Fàbregas and Henry. What he doesn't have yet is a derby goal.
lines.say: So Dowmun is ahead of Fabbregass and Onree. What he doesn't have yet, is a derby goal.

lines.text: Next Henry, next Cesc, or something bigger? Tell me in the comments.
lines.say: Next Onree, next Sesk, or something bigger? Tell me in the comments.

lines.text: Follow for more, and play Road to Ballon d'Or.
